claim: The Amazon Inspector image push date duration, which determines how long Amazon Inspector continuously monitors images after they are pushed, can be 3, 7, 14 (default), 30, 60, 90 or 180 days, or Lifetime.

qualifiers.scope: image push date duration setting of Amazon ECR scanning

evidence.quote:
+  3 days 
+  7 days 
+  14 days (default) 
+  30 days 
+  60 days 
+  90 days 
+  180 days 
+  Lifetime
The image push date duration determines how long Amazon Inspector will continuously monitor images after being pushed to repositories.
